limitations: No Digital Macaroni collection, recording, import, embed, analytics, export, billing, or support test was completed.
Claims that testimonials raise conversion cannot be generalized from vendor examples or individual customer accounts.

claims.statement: Testimonial collects text and video submissions on hosted pages and publishes approved items through links and embeds.
Fast setup, simple collection, imports, and no-code embeds are the main positive patterns.
Customization, video caps, branding, creator access, paid spaces, and price are meaningful limits.
Free includes ten text and two video testimonials. Starter is $25 monthly billed yearly. Ultimate is $50 monthly per space billed yearly. Ultimate Plus is $95 monthly per space billed yearly.

scoreRationale.onboarding: A collection page and first embed appear quick; the real test is whether customers can submit without help and consent remains clear.
scoreRationale.product: Useful for collecting, approving, organizing, and reusing proof without custom development; visual control and maintenance still need testing.
scoreRationale.support: Public support praise exists, but no request was tested.
scoreRationale.billing: Free is enough to prove the route, while unlimited video and multiple spaces become expensive quickly.
scoreRationale.overall: Ask ten real customers, review every permission and claim, embed the approved proof, change one item, remove one item, and compare the result with a simple form plus manual page.

conflictsAndUnknowns: An easy request can increase submissions and can produce vague praise.
Imports centralize proof and do not automatically preserve permission to reuse it elsewhere.
A Wall of Love is quick to publish and may be less persuasive than proof beside the relevant claim.
No hands-on collection, consent, embed, analytics, billing, or support test was completed.
